sentenceUpgrade.original: I think it is better to talk to people in person.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that, however advanced our communication technology becomes, certain conversations regain their true meaning only when they are conducted in person, where a glance and a pause can speak louder than a thousand emojis. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + however 引导让步从句 + only when 强调条件 + 对比修辞(a glance and a pause vs a thousand emojis)

original_sentence: In Mark Twain's Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the friendship forms between Huck Finn and Jim is an important theme of the book, though they appear to be an unlikely pair.
readingExamples: In Mark Twain's Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the friendship forms between Huck Finn and Jim is an important theme of the book, though they appear to be an unlikely pair.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, a speech, an artwork, or a discussion
(2) n. a particular idea or setting that connects and organizes an event, party, exhibition, or design
(3) n. a short melody or tune on which a longer piece of music is based; a recurring musical motif
(4) n. an idea or feeling that appears repeatedly throughout a work or a person's life

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 主旋律；主题曲（音乐）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the film's final scene faded, the familiar theme swelled once more, and half the audience found themselves humming it long after the lights came up. （读后续写·电影院·旋律记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （作定语）以某一主题为特色的，如 theme park 主题公园
uncommonMeanings.example: The disused factory had been transformed into a theme park of the imagination, where rusted machines now told stories to wide-eyed children. （读后续写·废墟重生·奇幻）

posExamples.sentence: As the old teacher turned the final page, he realized that loyalty had been the quiet theme running through his student's essay all along — a boy writing, without knowing it, about his own heart. （读后续写·师生·顿悟）
I am writing to propose that the theme of this year's English Festival be 'Bridges to the World', so that every performance can celebrate friendship across cultures. （应用文·建议信）

Throughout the great works of literature, the theme of the individual against an unjust society recurs again and again, reminding each generation that conscience must never bow to convenience. （议论文·文学与道德）
For our graduation party, we finally settled on a starry-night theme, and by dusk the hall shimmered with paper constellations we had spent a whole week folding. （读后续写·校园活动·温情）

collocations.example: The central theme of her speech — that kindness costs nothing yet changes everything — moved the entire hall to silence. （应用文·演讲）
Sacrifice for family is a recurring theme in Chinese literature, from ancient poems to modern novels. （议论文·文学分析）
In his final chapter the author explores the theme of forgiveness with startling tenderness. （读后续写·文学赏析）
This year's essay competition centres on the theme of resilience in the face of hardship. （应用文·通知）
The students staged a short play on the theme of environmental protection to mark Earth Day. （应用文·报道）
Our class trip to the science theme park turned an ordinary weekend into a day of wonder and laughter. （读后续写·校园生活）
The moment the theme song began to play, memories of that unforgettable summer came flooding back. （读后续写·怀旧）
We organized a 1980s theme party, and even our reserved head teacher showed up in a pair of retro sunglasses. （读后续写·趣味情节）
The judges praised her article for staying firmly on theme while still surprising readers with fresh examples. （应用文·点评）

synonyms.example: The debate topic — whether social media brings us closer or drives us apart — sparked a lively exchange of views. （议论文·辩论）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：topic 指讨论或写作的“具体话题、题目”，范围较窄、较具体；theme 指贯穿全文／作品的“中心思想、主题”，层次更深、更抽象。

synonyms.example: Courage under pressure was the subject he returned to in almost every story he wrote. （读后续写·文学）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：subject 泛指“所讨论／描写的对象、题材”，中性宽泛；theme 更强调作者借题材要传达的深层意涵和思想内核。

synonyms.translation: （艺术、文学中反复出现的）主题元素，母题
synonyms.example: The image of a lone candle appears as a recurring motif, symbolizing hope in the darkest chapters. （议论文·文学分析）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：motif 指作品中反复出现的“具体意象或元素”（如颜色、物件），是构成 theme 的部件；theme 是由这些 motif 共同烘托出的整体思想。

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp the theme that had quietly threaded through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she grasp the theme that had quietly threaded through every hardship of that year — that hope, once planted, refuses to die. （倒装+隐喻，续写结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: we have chosen ... as the theme, in the hope that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We have chosen 'Reaching Out' as the theme of this charity week, in the hope that every small act of kindness will ripple outward. （建议信/倡议句式，比喻升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the enduring theme of ... speaks to ... across generations
advancedExpressions.example: The enduring theme of perseverance speaks to readers across generations, precisely because struggle is written into the very fabric of human life. （中心论点句，abstract 名词化提升学术感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The theme of the book is friendship.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath its adventures and its winding river, the book carries a single, unshakeable theme — that true friendship recognizes no barrier of race or fortune, and that loyalty, once given, is worth more than freedom itself. （读后续写·文学点评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beneath ... 介词短语前置渲染 + 破折号引出主题 + that 引导同位语从句解释主题 + 递进对比(race or fortune / loyalty vs freedom)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many stories talk about the theme of hope.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is no coincidence that the theme of hope surfaces again and again across the world's great literature, for storytelling has always been humanity's way of insisting that darkness is never the final word. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is no coincidence that 强调句式 + surfaces again and again 生动动词 + for 引导原因分句 + 拟人/隐喻(darkness is never the final word)

original_sentence: Huck is a poor white boy father often beats him, while Jim is a black slave longs to be free.
readingExamples: Huck is a poor white boy father often beats him, while Jim is a black slave longs to be free.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who is legally owned by another person and forced to work for them without payment or freedom
(2) n. a person who is completely dominated by, or excessively devoted to, someone or something
(3) v. (usually 'slave away') to work extremely hard, often for long hours and with little reward

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拼命干活；苦干（常用 slave away）
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights she slaved over the design, fuelled by nothing but cold coffee and the stubborn belief that this time she would not fail. （读后续写·备赛·奋斗）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 受……支配的人；……的奴隶（比喻，常作 a slave to sth.）
uncommonMeanings.example: He had become a slave to other people's opinions, weighing every word he spoke against the fear of being judged. （读后续写·自我觉醒·心理）

posExamples.sentence: Born a slave and denied even the right to his own name, the old man had nonetheless kept alive, through every beating, a fierce and unbreakable dream of freedom. （读后续写·历史·人物）
I firmly believe that we should never become slaves to our smartphones; instead, we ought to be the masters of the technology we create. （应用文·演讲/倡议）
History reminds us, again and again, that no society can call itself civilized while it treats human beings as slaves, for the freedom of one is bound up with the freedom of all. （议论文·自由与人权）
While her classmates rested during the holiday, she slaved away in the school lab, convinced that opportunity favours only those who refuse to stop working. （读后续写·励志）

wordForms.other: enslave (vt. 使奴役); slave-driver (n. 苛刻的监工/工头)

idioms.translation: 赶时髦的人（贬义，指盲目追随潮流者）
idioms.example: She refused to be a slave to fashion, choosing instead the worn coat that carried her grandmother's memory. （读后续写·个性/亲情）
For weeks the volunteers worked like slaves to rebuild the flooded village, and not one of them uttered a word of complaint. （读后续写·集体·奉献）

collocations.example: Do not let yourself become a slave to your phone; put it down and truly look at the people around you. （应用文·倡议书）
The freed slaves gathered at dawn, blinking at a horizon that, for the first time, belonged to them. （读后续写·历史·自由时刻）
He slaved away at his experiments long after midnight, driven by a curiosity that no exhaustion could dampen. （读后续写·科研）
The runaway slave crept through the marshes by night, guided only by the North Star and an unquenchable hope. （读后续写·历史）
The museum's new exhibition traces the horrors of the slave trade so that no generation may forget them. （应用文·报道）
In that dark chapter of history, wealthy landowners bought and sold slaves as though they were mere property. （议论文·历史反思）

collocations.phrase: be a slave to one's emotions / habits
collocations.example: Once he learned to pause and breathe, he was no longer a slave to his own temper. （读后续写·成长）
Countless reformers devoted their lives to abolishing slavery, believing that liberty is the birthright of every human being. （议论文·社会变革）

synonyms.example: The loyal old servant had served three generations of the family, yet was treated with the warmth of a grandfather. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：servant 指“受雇为人服务的仆人”，享有人身自由、领取报酬；slave 指被他人合法拥有、毫无自由的奴隶，语义沉重得多。

synonyms.example: The captive was kept behind bars, but his spirit roamed as freely as ever. （读后续写·困境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：captive 强调“被抓获、被囚禁”的状态，常指战俘或人质，不一定被拥有；slave 强调“被作为财产拥有并强迫劳动”的身份。

advancedExpressions.expression: no chain could bind the ... within sb.
advancedExpressions.example: They could brand him a slave, but no chain could bind the free spirit that burned within him. （对比转折+隐喻，续写升华人物尊严）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us be the masters, not the slaves, of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us be the masters, not the slaves, of the technology we hold in our hands. （对比排比句式，倡议信呼吁段，master/slave 对照有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: a society that reduces people to slaves ultimately enslaves itself
advancedExpressions.example: A society that reduces people to slaves ultimately enslaves itself, for injustice, once tolerated, corrodes the conscience of all. （警句式论点，enslave 动词呼应+因果论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The slave wanted to be free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Chained by day yet unchained in dream, the young slave clung to a single image — a wide, open river carrying him toward a shore where no man could ever be bought or sold. （读后续写·渴望自由·意象）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Chained ... yet unchained 对比分词状语前置 + 破折号引出核心意象 + 意象象征(open river/free shore) + 定语从句延展

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not be controlled by our phones.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we asked ourselves a sobering question: are we still the masters of our smartphones, or have we quietly become their slaves, surrendering our attention one notification at a time? （议论文/演讲·反思句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time (that) 虚拟语气 + 冒号引出核心问题 + master/slave 对照反问 + one ... at a time 具象化收束

original_sentence: Then they leave the island together on a raft they find on the Mississippi River.
readingExamples: Then they leave the island together on a raft they find on the Mississippi River.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flat floating structure, usually made of logs, planks, or inflated material, used for travelling on or across water
(2) n. a small inflatable rubber or plastic boat, especially one used in emergencies or for water sports
(3) n. (a raft of sth.) a large number or amount of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大量，一批（a raft of sth.）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new headmaster arrived with a raft of ambitious reforms, and within a term the sleepy little school had come alive with clubs, contests and colour. （读后续写·校园变革·正能量）

posExamples.sentence: Lashing the last few logs together with trembling fingers, the two boys pushed their makeshift raft into the current and let the great river carry their friendship toward the unknown. （读后续写·冒险·友情）
During the summer camp, we will learn to build a raft from bamboo and ropes, an activity designed to teach teamwork and problem-solving in the wild. （应用文·活动通知）

When the floodwaters rose without warning, the villagers' hastily built rafts became the fragile boundary between survival and disaster — proof that human ingenuity shines brightest in crisis. （议论文·人类应对灾难）
As the storm swallowed the last strip of shore, they clung to the tiny rubber raft, four strangers now bound together by nothing but the will to see morning. （读后续写·海难·求生）

wordForms.verb: raft (v. 乘筏渡过；用筏运送)
wordForms.other: rafting (n. 漂流运动); white-water rafting (n. 激流漂流)

collocations.example: Stranded on the island, they set about building a raft from driftwood, refusing to let despair take hold. （读后续写·荒岛求生）
The rescue team paddled an inflatable raft toward the overturned boat as the crowd on the bank held its breath. （读后续写·营救）
Drifting downstream on a raft, they watched the forest slide past in a green blur and felt, for once, entirely free. （读后续写·旅途）
When the ferry began to list, the crew calmly guided the passengers into the life rafts one by one. （应用文·事故报道）
Our club is organizing a white-water rafting trip this weekend, so please sign up early if you long for a thrill. （应用文·招募通知）
The government introduced a raft of measures to protect the endangered river dolphins. （议论文·环保政策）
He paddled the raft with steady, practised strokes, steering it clear of the jagged rocks ahead. （读后续写·河上历险）

synonyms.example: They rowed the little boat across the still lake as the first light of dawn gilded the water. （读后续写·清晨湖上）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：boat 泛指各种小船，通常有船身、船底；raft 是平底、无船体的“筏子”，多由圆木或充气材料拼成，更简陋原始。

synonyms.example: The battered vessel limped into harbour after weathering the fiercest storm of the decade. （读后续写·航海）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：vessel 是“船只、舰艇”的正式书面用词，多指较大船舶；raft 特指最简易的漂浮工具，二者体量与语体差别很大。

advancedExpressions.expression: the fragile raft was all that stood between them and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Now the fragile raft was all that stood between them and the hungry darkness of the sea. （对比反衬+拟人(hungry darkness)，续写渲染绝境）

advancedExpressions.expression: join us as we ... , learning to ... together
advancedExpressions.example: Join us this summer as we brave the rapids on a raft, learning to trust one another and to conquer fear together. （倡议/招募句式，动名词并列点明活动意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: much like a raft in a flood, ... keeps ... afloat when ...
advancedExpressions.example: Much like a raft in a flood, a resilient spirit keeps us afloat when the currents of misfortune threaten to pull us under. （明喻类比论证，raft 作喻体升华主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They left the island on a raft.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the first grey light crept over the water, they shoved off from the island on a raft lashed together from broken branches, two friends surrendering themselves to a river that would decide their fate. （读后续写·启程·氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语从句铺陈晨光 + 具体化(lashed from broken branches) + 拟人(a river that would decide their fate) + 分词短语收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The government made many new rules to protect rivers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to mounting public concern, the authorities rolled out a raft of stringent measures aimed at safeguarding the nation's rivers, signalling at last a determination to place ecology above short-term profit. （议论文·政策评述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In response to 状语引出背景 + a raft of 熟词僻义(大量) + aimed at 分词后置定语 + signalling 结果状语点明意义

translation: 最有意思（或最令人愉快、最好）的部分
original_sentence: The high point of the story comes when Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers.
readingExamples: The high point of the story comes when Huck is faced with the decision of whether to hand Jim over to some slave catchers.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the best, most exciting, or most successful part of an event, experience, or period of time
(2) n. the climax or most memorable moment in a story, performance, or journey
(3) n. a moment of greatest achievement or intensity in someone's life or career

posExamples.sentence: Looking back, she knew the high point of that entire summer had not been winning the medal, but the moment her father, tears in his eyes, whispered that he had never been prouder. （读后续写·亲情·顿悟）
The high point of our school trip was undoubtedly the evening by the campfire, when strangers became friends and shy voices rose together in song. （应用文·游记/报道）
The high point of any truly great novel comes not from its grandest event, but from that quiet instant when a character must choose between comfort and conscience. （议论文·文学·观点）
For weeks the choir had rehearsed in secret, and the high point arrived when the curtain rose and the whole hall fell silent, waiting for their first note. （读后续写·演出·期待）

collocations.example: The high point of the ceremony was the moment the oldest graduate returned to hand the youngest student a single, symbolic candle. （读后续写·典礼）
In the play, the high point comes when the estranged brothers finally clasp hands, and the audience releases a breath it did not know it was holding. （读后续写·戏剧）
Her career reached its high point when her research was recognized on the world stage. （应用文·人物介绍）
That unforgettable duet marked the high point of the entire music festival. （应用文·报道）
The emotional high point of the film left not a single dry eye in the cinema. （读后续写·观影）
Volunteering at the shelter was, without question, a definite high point of my entire year. （应用文·感想）
Meeting my long-lost pen friend was one of the high points of the whole exchange programme. （应用文·交流总结）

synonyms.example: The highlight of the evening was a surprise performance by the shy new boy, whose voice silenced the entire room. （读后续写·惊喜）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：highlight 与 high point 意思很接近，都指“最精彩之处”，highlight 更口语常用、也可指“节目集锦”；high point 稍显具体，常强调“情感或情节的顶点”。

synonyms.example: The story builds slowly toward its climax, where every secret is at last laid bare. （议论文·文学分析）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：climax 特指叙事或事件层层推进后的“最高潮、转折顶点”，学术味更浓；high point 泛指“最精彩／最愉快的部分”，不一定是结构上的顶点。

synonyms.translation: 顶峰，高峰（多指状态、成就）
synonyms.example: At the peak of her fame, she chose to walk away and quietly teach in a mountain village. （读后续写·人物抉择）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：peak 常指能力、成就、事业等“达到最高水平的顶峰状态”；high point 更侧重某段经历中“最精彩、最难忘的时刻或环节”。

advancedExpressions.expression: the true high point was not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true high point of that day was not the trophy in her hands, but the sight of her mother clapping through tears in the last row. （对比转折+画面定格，续写点睛，重心落在情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: the high point for me was undoubtedly ...
advancedExpressions.example: The high point for me was undoubtedly the moment we finished the mural together and stepped back to admire what teamwork had created. （感想信/总结句式，undoubtedly 强化真情实感）

advancedExpressions.expression: the high point of ... lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The high point of any education lies not in the grades we collect, but in the moment a student first thinks for himself. （对比论点句，抽象名词提升思辨深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The best part of the trip was climbing the mountain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The high point of the trip came at dawn on the summit, when the clouds parted like a curtain and the whole valley below glowed gold — a view so breathtaking that, for a long moment, no one dared to speak. （读后续写·登顶·景色）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: high point ... came at 时间地点铺陈 + 明喻(clouds parted like a curtain) + 感官细节(glowed gold) + so ... that 结果状语收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The most exciting moment of the story is when Huck decides to help Jim.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The high point of the story comes when Huck, torn between the law he has been taught and the friend he has come to love, tears up the letter and declares, 'All right, then, I'll go to hell' — a single act of conscience that redeems the entire novel. （议论文·文学点评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: high point comes when 引出高潮 + 插入分词短语渲染内心挣扎(torn between...) + 引语点睛 + 破折号后同位语升华主题意义

translation: 不顾艰难险阻，同甘共苦
original_sentence: From this story we can see that friends are people support you through thick and thin.
readingExamples: From this story we can see that friends are people support you through thick and thin.
definitionEn:
(1) idiom. through both good times and bad; despite every difficulty, hardship, or obstacle
(2) idiom. remaining loyal, supportive, and steadfast no matter what happens
(3) idiom. under all circumstances, whatever the cost or challenge

posExamples.sentence: Through thick and thin they had stood side by side — through the failed harvests, the sleepless nights, the whispered doubts of neighbours — and now, at last, the little farm was blooming again. （读后续写·患难与共·收获）
On behalf of the graduating class, I want to thank the teachers who guided us through thick and thin and never once gave up on the students others had written off. （应用文·感谢信/致辞）

A true friend, as history and literature alike remind us, is not one who shares only our triumphs, but one who stands by us through thick and thin, when applause fades and hardship sets in. （议论文·友谊的本质）
The two climbers had promised to see it through together, and through thick and thin — the biting cold, the failing light, the treacherous ice — neither would let go of the other's rope. （读后续写·登山·信念）

idioms.idiom: stand by sb. through thick and thin
idioms.translation: 无论顺境逆境都陪伴／支持某人
idioms.example: No matter how the world turned against him, his old dog stood by him through thick and thin, a silent witness to every fall and every rise. （读后续写·忠诚·陪伴）

idioms.idiom: stick / stay together through thick and thin
idioms.example: The team had stuck together through thick and thin, and that unspoken bond was worth more than any trophy. （读后续写·团队）

collocations.phrase: support sb. through thick and thin
collocations.translation: 在任何情况下都支持某人
collocations.example: My parents supported me through thick and thin, believing in my dream even when I had almost stopped believing in it myself. （读后续写·亲情）

collocations.phrase: stand by sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: A real friend is someone who will stand by you through thick and thin, asking for nothing in return. （议论文·友谊）

collocations.phrase: stay / stick together through thick and thin
collocations.example: Having stuck together through thick and thin, the classmates parted at graduation with tears they no longer tried to hide. （读后续写·毕业）

collocations.phrase: remain loyal / faithful through thick and thin
collocations.example: The old servant remained loyal through thick and thin, long after wealth and fortune had deserted the family. （读后续写·忠诚）

collocations.phrase: see sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: It was her unshakeable optimism that saw the whole family through thick and thin during those lean years. （读后续写·家庭）

collocations.phrase: be with sb. through thick and thin
collocations.example: I promise to be with you through thick and thin, whatever storms the future may bring. （应用文·信件/誓言）

synonyms.example: They had learned to love each other in good times and bad, and that, she realized, was what a family truly meant. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in good times and bad 直白平实，语气中性，书面口语皆可；through thick and thin 是固定习语，更凝练、更有文学感染力，尤宜作文亮点。

synonyms.translation: 无论风雨（不管发生什么）

definitionEn:

(2) n. the beliefs or views of a group of people (usually 'public opinion' / 'opinion')

posExamples.sentence: I have learned that to respect my brother's choices, even the ones I cannot understand, is itself the deepest form of love I can offer him. （读后续写·亲情·成长感悟）
I am writing to express my sincere respect for the volunteers whose tireless efforts turned our neglected schoolyard into a garden the whole town now admires. （应用文·感谢信）
Mutual respect, rather than blind obedience, is what allows different cultures to coexist in genuine harmony. （议论文·多元文化·观点论证）
A truly civilised traveller respects the customs of every place he visits, treating each unfamiliar tradition with curiosity rather than contempt. （议论文·文明素养）

idioms.idiom: with respect to / in respect of
idioms.example: With respect to the choice of destination, the whole class was, for once, in perfect agreement. （应用文·活动方案）
Hundreds gathered in silence to pay their last respects to the doctor who had given forty years to their small town. （读后续写·缅怀）
He was stubborn, careless, often late; but in one respect he never failed us: he always told the truth. （读后续写·人物·欲扬先抑）

collocations.example: Deep respect for nature lies at the heart of every culture that has learned to live in balance with the land. （议论文·人与自然）
The young captain earned the respect of every teammate not by giving orders but by working harder than them all. （读后续写·领导力）
We should treat every worker, however humble their job, with the same respect we show the powerful. （议论文·平等）
Their friendship survived every argument because it rested on a foundation of mutual respect. （读后续写·友情）
Out of respect for the sleeping baby, the whole room fell instantly, tenderly silent. （读后续写·温情细节）

collocations.translation: 尊重某人的意愿/隐私/意见
collocations.example: A good friend knows when to speak and, more importantly, when to respect your silence. （读后续写·友情）
The old headmaster never raised his voice, yet his quiet dignity commanded the respect of the entire school. （读后续写·人物气场）

collocations.translation: 恕我直言(表达不同意见前的礼貌语)
collocations.example: With all due respect, sir, I believe the students deserve to be heard before the decision is made. （应用文·辩论/发言）
In a single dishonest moment, he lost the respect it had taken him years to win. （读后续写·信任崩塌）
I must respect and support the choices my brother makes, even when my heart quietly wishes he would choose otherwise. （应用文·日记）

synonyms.example: I had always admired my sister's calm, but it was only in crisis that I truly understood the strength behind it. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:admire 侧重因才华/成就而'欣赏、仰慕',情感更热烈;respect 侧重因品格/地位而'敬重',并含以礼相待之意

synonyms.example: The professor was held in the highest esteem by students and colleagues alike. （议论文·人物评价）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:esteem 更正式、书面,程度更高(hold sb. in high esteem);respect 通用、口笔皆宜

synonyms.example: We honour our teachers best not with flowers but by living out the lessons they taught us. （议论文·尊师）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:honour 带'给予荣誉、隆重敬重'之意,程度更庄重;respect 日常、语气更平和

synonyms.example: A wise leader values every voice in the room, especially the ones too timid to speak first. （议论文·领导力）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:value 强调'重视其价值';respect 强调'因其可敬而敬重并礼待',对象常为人及其权利/意愿

advancedExpressions.expression: to respect sb.'s ... is itself the deepest form of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I finally understood that to respect his silence was itself the deepest form of love — for love does not always mean rescuing; sometimes it means simply staying near. （抽象定义+破折号哲理，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to express my sincere respect for ...

advancedExpressions.expression: mutual respect, rather than ..., is what allows ...
advancedExpressions.example: Mutual respect, rather than mere tolerance, is what allows a diverse society to move from coexistence to genuine harmony. （rather than 对比+what 强调，论证有层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I respect my father very much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: My respect for my father ran deeper than words could carry — it was written in every value he had quietly passed to me, in every principle I now held without ever having been told to. （读后续写·亲情·内化升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: My respect for...ran deeper than words could carry 名词化+夸张 + 破折号+it was written in 隐喻 + without ever having been told 分词状语显潜移默化

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should respect each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we hope to build a society worth living in, we must first learn to treat one another with respect — not the hollow politeness of strangers, but the genuine regard that sees, in every face, a story as complex as our own. （议论文·尊重的真谛）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If we hope to..., we must first 条件+主张 + treat...with respect 正式搭配 + not...but 对比澄清概念 + sees...a story as complex as our own 共情升华

original_sentence: I should also encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties.
readingExamples: I should also encourage him to take action to get over these difficulties.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to become well again after an illness, or to feel better after an unpleasant experience
(2) phr. v. to deal with or gain control of a problem or difficulty; to overcome
(3) phr. v. to succeed in making an idea or feeling clear to someone (usually 'get sth. over to sb.')
(4) phr. v. (get sth. over with) to finish something difficult or unpleasant as quickly as possible

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把(想法/意思)讲清楚、传达给某人(get sth. over to sb.)
uncommonMeanings.example: However hard she tried, she simply could not get over to her stubborn father just how much this one chance meant to her. （读后续写·亲子沟通·无力感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (get sth. over with)硬着头皮把(难事)做完、了结
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than dread the apology for another sleepless night, he decided to get it over with — and knocked on her door before his courage could fail. （读后续写·鼓起勇气）

posExamples.sentence: It took her the whole of that grey autumn to get over the loss of her grandmother, and even then, some small ache lingered quietly, like the last leaf refusing to fall. （读后续写·丧亲·情感描写）
I should encourage my brother to take action and get over these difficulties instead of letting them weigh silently on his heart. （应用文·日记）
History teaches us that no nation truly rises until it learns to get over the wounds of its past and turn its energy toward the future. （议论文·历史与发展·观点论证）
Slowly, painfully, he began to get over his fear of the water, and one bright morning he finally let go of the rail and swam. （读后续写·克服恐惧·成长）

idioms.translation: 对某事惊讶不已,无法平静
idioms.example: She couldn't get over how much the shy boy had changed; the trembling newcomer had become the calm captain of the team. （读后续写·惊叹于人物蜕变）

collocations.example: It took my grandfather a long, patient month to get over the fever, but his spirit never once dimmed. （读后续写·亲情）
With his friends' encouragement, he found the strength to get over one difficulty after another. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: get over the loss / death of sb.
collocations.translation: 从丧失/丧亲的痛苦中走出
collocations.example: Time alone rarely helps us get over the loss of a loved one; only love and gentle company truly can. （议论文·情感）
To get over her stage fright, she practised her speech before the mirror every single night for a month. （读后续写·励志）
What matters is not how quickly we get over a setback, but what we choose to become because of it. （议论文·挫折教育）
Take a deep breath, walk in, and get the interview over with — the fear is always larger than the moment itself. （读后续写·心理鼓励）
It took him a whole summer to get over the quarrel that had ended their long friendship. （读后续写·情感修复）

collocations.translation: 帮助某人克服/走出某事
collocations.example: A single kind word from a stranger helped her get over the darkest week of her life. （读后续写·善意的力量）

synonyms.example: Against every expectation, she overcame her disability and crossed the finish line to a roar of applause. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:overcome 更正式、力度更强,多用于战胜困难/情绪/敌人,议论文常用;get over 更口语,兼指'康复'与'释怀'

synonyms.example: It took the small town years to recover from the flood, yet its people rebuilt with unbroken hope. （读后续写·灾后重建）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:recover from 侧重'恢复健康/元气/常态',较中性正式;get over 更强调'情感上释怀'与'不再受困扰'

synonyms.translation: 接受并释怀(尤指痛苦事实)
synonyms.example: In time, she came to terms with the fact that some goodbyes are simply forever. （读后续写·丧亲·和解）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:come to terms with 强调'与痛苦事实达成和解、接受它',情感更深沉;get over 更侧重'彻底走出、不再难受'

synonyms.example: Determined not to be defeated, the young climber finally conquered the peak that had turned back so many before him. （读后续写·挑战极限）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:conquer 语气最强,多指征服艰巨挑战/极限;get over 日常、平和,程度较轻

advancedExpressions.expression: it took sb. ... to get over ..., and even then ...
advancedExpressions.example: It took me an entire winter to get over the falling-out with my closest friend, and even then, a quiet corner of my heart still kept the door ajar. （时间跨度+even then 转折，刻画余留情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I encourage you to take action and get over ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely encourage you to face the setback and get over it step by step, for I firmly believe brighter days lie just ahead. （安慰信/建议信中鼓励句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: what matters is not how quickly we get over ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What matters is not how quickly we get over failure, but what wisdom we carry forward from its bitter lessons. （not...but 转移焦点，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He finally got over his sadness.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Little by little, the way winter melts into spring, he got over the sadness that had shadowed him for months — until one ordinary morning he caught himself smiling, and did not know why. （读后续写·情感复苏·细节升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Little by little+比喻(winter melts into spring) 渐进节奏 + that had shadowed him 定语从句 + caught himself smiling, and did not know why 细节收束显自然疗愈

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should help students get over their difficulties.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than shield students from every hardship, we would do better to stand beside them and help them get over their difficulties on their own — for the confidence born of a battle won is a lesson no textbook can teach. （议论文·教育理念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than...we would do better to 对比建议 + on their own 强调自主 + for 引导原因 + the confidence born of...no textbook can teach 抽象升华

original_sentence: When he's struggling with his schoolwork, I should do all I can to help him become a more efficient learner.
readingExamples: When he's struggling with his schoolwork, I should do all I can to help him become a more efficient learner.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. working well and producing good results by using time, energy, or resources without wasting any
(2) adj. (of a person) skilful and competent, performing tasks in an organised and productive way
(3) adj. (of a machine, system, or process) achieving maximum output with minimum wasted effort or expense

posExamples.sentence: Watching the old craftsman work, I marvelled at how efficient his weathered hands were — not a single movement wasted, each stroke of the chisel landing exactly where it was meant to. （读后续写·人物观察）
I am writing to suggest that our school adopt a more efficient recycling system, so that the paper and plastic we discard each day can be sorted and reused rather than dumped. （应用文·建议信）
Far from making us lazy, an efficient use of technology frees the mind from tedious labour and channels our energy into creative thinking, where true value is created. （议论文·科技与效率）
When he was struggling with maths, I sat beside him each evening, patiently showing him how to become a more efficient learner rather than simply memorising answers. （读后续写·友谊/互助）

collocations.example: To help him become a more efficient learner, I taught him to break each task into small, manageable steps. （读后续写·互助）
Switching to energy-efficient light bulbs across the campus would cut our electricity bills and reduce carbon emissions at the same time. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.phrase: an efficient way / method of doing sth
collocations.example: Group discussion proved to be a far more efficient way of revising than reading alone in silence. （议论文·学习方法）
The volunteers formed a highly efficient team, and within two hours the flooded classroom had been cleared and cleaned. （读后续写·集体行动）
A well-planned timetable can make your revision far more efficient and spare you the panic of last-minute cramming. （应用文·经验分享）

collocations.translation: 对时间／资源的高效利用
collocations.example: The efficient use of every spare minute between classes gradually transformed her from an average student into a top scholar. （读后续写·励志成长）
Buying stationery in bulk is a cost-efficient choice that leaves more funds for the charity event. （应用文·活动方案）
For the whole system to run efficiently, every member must know exactly what he or she is responsible for. （议论文·协作）

synonyms.example: The teacher's gentle encouragement proved far more effective than any punishment in motivating the shy boy. （读后续写·师生）
synonyms.usage: efficient 强调过程不浪费时间／资源(高效);effective 强调结果达到了目的(有效)。两者高考常被混用,写作时须分清是夸"省"还是夸"成"。

synonyms.example: By silencing my phone and focusing fully, I turned a normally distracted afternoon into a remarkably productive one. （应用文·经验分享）
synonyms.usage: productive 侧重"产出多、成果丰";efficient 侧重"投入少、不浪费"。同样的努力,productive 看收成,efficient 看性价比。

synonyms.example: Though only a trainee, she handled the emergency with the calm assurance of a competent professional. （读后续写·人物能力）
synonyms.usage: competent 指人有能力把事做好,偏"胜任";efficient 指人做事又快又省。夸人能干可用 competent,夸人做事利落用 efficient。

advancedExpressions.expression: with an efficiency that + 从句, sb. + 动作
advancedExpressions.example: With an efficiency that belied his years, the boy repacked the whole tent in under a minute, his hands moving as if guided by memory alone. （用 with an efficiency that... 抽象名词短语替代副词,画面更凝练）

advancedExpressions.expression: a more efficient approach would be to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than reminding students individually, a more efficient approach would be to display the schedule on a shared online board that everyone can check at a glance. （提出更优方案的委婉句式,礼貌而有说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: efficiency should never come at the expense of ...
advancedExpressions.example: In our relentless pursuit of efficiency, we must remember that efficiency should never come at the expense of kindness, patience, or the human touch that machines can never replicate. （让步-警示结构,升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked in an efficient way.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every task he touched dissolved into a series of clean, unhurried movements — no fuss, no wasted breath — as though efficiency were not a skill he had learned but a rhythm he had been born to. （读后续写·人物特写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入具体动作细节(no fuss, no wasted breath) + as though 虚拟比喻把"高效"升华为天性 + 抽象名词 efficiency 作主语

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use our time more efficiently.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that only by using our limited time efficiently — planning each day with purpose and cutting out aimless distractions — can we transform fleeting hours into lasting achievements. （议论文·时间管理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 正式主句 + only by + doing 引导的部分倒装 + 破折号补充具体做法 + 对比升华(fleeting hours → lasting achievements)

translation: 额外的，分外的，附加的 | adv. 额外，另外；特别，格外
original_sentence: It'll take up some of my spare time, but this friendship is worth my extra time and effort.
readingExamples: It'll take up some of my spare time, but this friendship is worth my extra time and effort.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. more than the usual, expected, or necessary amount; additional
(2) adv. more than usually; especially, particularly
(3) adv. in addition to what is normal or included
(4) n. something added that is not part of the standard price or plan; a person hired for a minor background role in a film

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电影中的）群众演员，临时演员
uncommonMeanings.example: For three whole days she stood in the crowd as an unnamed extra, but her eyes never left the leading actress, silently rehearsing the dream that one day the camera would find her too. （读后续写·追梦·小角色的野心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 额外收费的项目；附加物
uncommonMeanings.example: The room looked cheap online, yet every comfort — breakfast, Wi-Fi, even a towel — turned out to be a costly extra. （读后续写·旅途·意外的失望）

posExamples.sentence: It would take up some of my spare time, but I decided this friendship was worth every bit of the extra effort I would have to put in. （读后续写·友谊）
We are calling on all students to donate any extra books gathering dust on their shelves, so that children in remote mountain schools may share the joy of reading. （应用文·倡议书）
Knowing the roads would be icy after the storm, my father drove extra carefully, his hands tight on the wheel and his eyes fixed on the winding path ahead. （读后续写·亲情·紧张时刻）
Those who are willing to go the extra mile — to revise one more chapter, to check one more answer — are precisely the ones who reap the sweetest rewards in the end. （议论文·努力与回报）

idioms.translation: 付出额外努力，加倍尽力
idioms.example: It was her willingness to go the extra mile — staying behind to comfort a frightened classmate — that finally won her the trust of the whole team. （读后续写·品格·真诚待人）

collocations.example: This friendship is worth my extra time and effort, however busy my schedule may be. （读后续写·友谊）
A little extra effort each morning, however small, adds up over a term into a difference no one can ignore. （议论文·积累）

collocations.phrase: an extra hand / pair of hands
collocations.example: Seeing the elderly farmer struggle with the heavy sacks, I ran over to lend an extra hand. （读后续写·助人）
The whole class put in extra hours after school, determined not to let a single teammate fall behind. （读后续写·集体）
The workshop is completely free, with no extra charge for the materials we provide. （应用文·通知）
Students who need extra help with their English are warmly encouraged to join our weekly reading club. （应用文·招募）

collocations.phrase: an extra bit of / a little extra
collocations.example: Just a little extra patience on my part turned our arguments into calm conversations. （读后续写·和解）
Handling the injured bird demanded extra care, and I cupped it in my palms as if it were made of glass. （读后续写·细节描写）

synonyms.example: For additional information about the volunteer programme, please feel free to contact me at any time. （应用文·书信）
synonyms.usage: additional 更正式、书面,常用于应用文/说明中;extra 更口语、日常,也可作副词修饰动词/形容词。写正式通知选 additional,写记叙/对话选 extra。

synonyms.example: In my spare time I taught the migrant children to read, and their laughter became the highlight of my week. （读后续写·志愿）
synonyms.usage: spare 强调"备用、闲置"(spare time / a spare key);extra 强调"超出常量、额外增加"。两者都可指时间,但 spare 侧重"空出来的",extra 侧重"多加的"。

synonyms.example: The teacher handed out supplementary exercises for anyone eager to stretch beyond the textbook. （应用文·学习）
synonyms.usage: supplementary 学术味浓,指对已有内容的"补充完善"(supplementary reading);extra 更通用、口语化。写议论文或说明性文字用 supplementary 更显水平。

advancedExpressions.expression: willing to go the extra mile, sb. + 具体行动
advancedExpressions.example: Always willing to go the extra mile, she stayed long after the others had left, gently coaxing the last stray dog into the shelter's warmth. （用 go the extra mile 的分词状语开头,以具体善行体现品格）

advancedExpressions.expression: we sincerely hope everyone can spare a little extra ... for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely hope everyone can spare a little extra time and warmth for these lonely elderly people, for whom a single visit means more than we can imagine. （"spare a little extra... for..." 温暖的号召句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the extra ... that makes all the difference
advancedExpressions.example: Between success and failure often lies the thinnest of margins; more often than not, it is the extra hour of practice, the extra ounce of persistence, that makes all the difference. （强调句 + 排比 extra 短语,突出"多一分"的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I spent extra time helping my friend.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Evening after evening, I set aside the extra time I could ill afford, sitting shoulder to shoulder with him under the desk lamp until the hardest problems finally yielded and a shy smile crept across his tired face. （读后续写·友谊/互助）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语开头(Evening after evening)营造持续感 + 让步细节(I could ill afford)体现付出 + 环境描写(under the desk lamp) + 以对方神态收束(a shy smile crept across)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hard-working people do a little extra every day.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Those who... 定语从句作主语 + 破折号内三项排比(one more...) + 建筑隐喻(laying brick by brick... foundation) + 升华收尾(a future far grander than they dare to dream)

original_sentence: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person.
readingExamples: To me, a good friend brings out the best in a person.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to make a quality, feeling, or the best/worst in someone become noticeable or develop
(2) phr. v. to produce something and make it available to the public, such as a new product or book
(3) phr. v. to make something easier to see, taste, or understand; to emphasise or highlight it
(4) phr. v. to take something out from where it is kept and show it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 出版，推出（新产品、书、专辑等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Two years after that rainy afternoon in the bookshop, the shy girl who had once hidden her poems in a drawer finally brought out a slim volume of verse — and the whole town lined up to buy it. （读后续写·追梦·从自卑到发光）

posExamples.sentence: To me, a true friend is someone who brings out the best in you — who sees the courage you cannot see in yourself and quietly dares you to become it. （读后续写·友谊）
We firmly believe that team sports bring out qualities such as cooperation and perseverance, which no textbook alone can ever teach. （应用文·倡议书）
Adversity, far from crushing us, often brings out the resilience that lies dormant within — the very strength we never knew we possessed until life demanded it. （议论文·逆境与成长）

collocations.phrase: bring out the best in sb

collocations.phrase: bring out the worst in sb
collocations.example: Pressure, if left unchecked, can bring out the worst in a team, turning friends into rivals overnight. （议论文·竞争）
A patient mentor can bring out the hidden talent that a harsh critic would only crush. （读后续写·师生）
A pinch of salt, my grandmother told me, brings out the sweetness in every dish — and, she added with a wink, in every person too. （读后续写·亲情·生活哲理）

collocations.phrase: bring out a new product / book / album
collocations.example: The young inventor promised to bring out an affordable version so that every rural school could own one. （应用文·报道）

collocations.translation: 使某种品质／情感显现出来
collocations.example: Volunteering at the shelter brought out a tenderness in my brother that none of us had ever seen. （读后续写·成长）
A well-chosen example can bring out the meaning of an abstract idea far better than pages of explanation. （议论文·论证方法）

synonyms.example: As the mask of composure slipped, her trembling voice revealed just how frightened she truly was. （读后续写·情感揭示）
synonyms.usage: reveal 指"揭开、使显露"原本隐藏的东西,较正式;bring out 更强调"引发、使显现并发展"某种品质或潜能,含"激发"意味。

synonyms.example: The old photograph elicited a flood of memories neither of them had dared to speak of for years. （读后续写·回忆）
synonyms.usage: elicit 学术色彩强,指"引出反应、回答、情感";bring out 更口语、更常指"激发内在品质"。写议论文用 elicit 显水平,写记叙用 bring out 更自然。

synonyms.example: In my speech I wish to highlight the courage of ordinary volunteers whose names history rarely records. （应用文·演讲）
synonyms.usage: highlight 侧重"使某点格外醒目"(信息/重点);bring out 侧重"使内在特质显现"或"衬托味道"。强调要点用 highlight,激发品质用 bring out。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·友谊/品格升华
advancedExpressions.expression: a true friend is one who brings out the ... you cannot see in yourself
advancedExpressions.example: A true friend, I have come to understand, is one who brings out the strength you cannot see in yourself and holds up a mirror until you finally believe it is there. （下定义式升华句,适合续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: such activities can bring out qualities that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Such activities can bring out qualities of teamwork and responsibility that will benefit us long after our school days are over. （"bring out qualities that..." 论证活动价值,说服力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is often adversity, not comfort, that brings out ...
advancedExpressions.example: History teaches us a humbling truth: it is often adversity, not comfort, that brings out the finest qualities of the human spirit. （强调句 + 对比 not comfort,增强论辩张力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good friend brings out the best in you.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A good friend is like a still lake at dawn — standing before them, you see reflected the bravest, kindest version of yourself, and, almost without noticing, you begin to grow into it. （读后续写·友谊·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like a still lake at dawn)将"激发"具象化 + 倒装式地点状语(standing before them) + 渐进收尾(almost without noticing, you begin to grow)化"bring out"为诗意画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Difficulties can bring out our strength.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from breaking us, the hardships we dread most often serve to bring out reserves of strength we never knew we carried — much as fire, rather than destroying gold, only reveals its purity. （议论文·逆境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from + doing 让步开头扭转常识 + serve to 提升正式度 + much as 引导的类比(fire...gold)完成论证升华 + reserves of strength 高级名词化表达

translation: 估量，判定；测量 | n. 措施；衡量
original_sentence: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship develops.
readingExamples: I'll always value these qualities of a good friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship develops.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to find the exact size, amount, degree, or rate of something using standard units
(2) v. to judge or assess the importance, value, or quality of someone or something
(3) n. an official action taken to achieve a particular aim or deal with a problem
(4) n. a way of judging or measuring something; an amount or degree of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某种）程度，一定量
uncommonMeanings.example: After months of silence between us, even a small measure of forgiveness felt like the first warm ray of spring breaking through a long, hard winter. （读后续写·和解·抽象量度）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （measure up to）达到（标准／期望）
uncommonMeanings.example: For years he feared he would never measure up to his father's towering reputation — until the night he saved a drowning child and understood that his own worth had never depended on comparison. （读后续写·自我认同·熟词僻义）

posExamples.sentence: I will always treasure these qualities of a true friend and try to measure myself by these standards as our friendship deepens over the years. （读后续写·友谊/自省）
We urge the school to take immediate measures to reduce food waste in the canteen, such as offering smaller portions and rewarding students who finish their meals. （应用文·倡议书）
The true measure of a person, in my view, lies not in the wealth they accumulate but in the lives they quietly touch along the way. （议论文·人生价值）
With trembling hands the young tailor measured the fabric a third time, terrified that a single wrong cut would ruin the only silk his family could ever afford. （读后续写·细节/紧张）

idioms.translation: 评判某人／某物的真正标准
idioms.example: The measure of a man, my grandfather always said, is how he treats those who can do nothing for him in return. （读后续写·家训·人生哲理）
When she finally read my name on the list of winners, my mother's joy was beyond measure, and tears streamed silently down her weathered cheeks. （读后续写·亲情·喜悦）
He packed extra water, a first-aid kit, and, for good measure, a torch — for the mountain trail was famously unforgiving after dark. （读后续写·出行准备）
Deep down she wondered whether her humble little essay could ever measure up to the polished work of her classmates. （读后续写·自我怀疑）

collocations.example: Unless we take effective measures to protect them now, these ancient forests may vanish within a generation. （议论文·环保）
I try to measure myself by the standards of a true friend: honesty, patience, and unwavering loyalty. （读后续写·自省）
Strict safety measures were put in place before the students were allowed near the laboratory equipment. （应用文·通知）

collocations.phrase: a measure of success / trust / comfort
collocations.translation: 一定程度的成功／信任／安慰
collocations.example: Her kind words offered me a measure of comfort I had not felt since the accident. （读后续写·情感）
The true measure of education is not how many facts we memorise but how wisely we learn to think. （议论文·教育）
Carefully, the young scientist measured the temperature of the water every ten minutes and recorded each figure in her notebook. （读后续写·实验/专注）

collocations.translation: 严厉的／严格的／有效的措施
collocations.example: The government took drastic measures to curb pollution, and within a year the once-grey sky began to turn blue again. （议论文·治理）
The old tailor was famous for his made-to-measure suits, each stitched to fit its owner as if it were a second skin. （读后续写·工匠）

synonyms.example: Before offering advice, a wise teacher first pauses to assess what the student truly needs. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: assess 指经过判断给出"评估结论",偏正式、书面;measure 作"衡量"时更强调"以某标准去量度"。评估价值/情况用 assess,以标准衡量用 measure。

synonyms.example: From the silence on the other end of the line, I struggled to gauge how my father had taken the news. （读后续写·揣度）
synonyms.usage: gauge 侧重"凭线索估量难以确定的东西"(情绪/反应),不确定性强;measure 侧重"精确量度"。摸不准时用 gauge,能量化时用 measure。

synonyms.example: Planting one tree may seem trivial, yet it is a concrete step towards a greener future. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: 作"措施"讲时,step 指"为达目的迈出的一步",较口语;measure 更正式,常指官方/系统的举措。写倡议用 step 亲切,写议论/公文用 measure 庄重。

advancedExpressions.expression: the true measure of ... lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: That day I finally understood that the true measure of friendship lies not in the gifts we exchange but in the silences we can share without fear. （下定义+not...but...对比,续写点题金句）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is high time we took measures to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is high time we took concrete measures to protect our campus environment before litter buries the beauty we once took pride in. （it is high time + 虚拟过去式,呼吁力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should measure sth not by ... but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should measure progress not by the speed at which we advance, but by the number of people we manage to bring along with us. （measure...not by...but by... 平行结构,重塑评价标准）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to measure myself by the standards of a good friend.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the years unfold, I have quietly vowed to hold myself up against the standards of a true friend — honesty, patience, loyalty — and to keep measuring, however painful the reckoning, until I grow worthy of the word. （读后续写·自省）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语开头(As the years unfold)拉开叙事纵深 + 破折号列举三品质 + 让步插入(however painful the reckoning) + 抽象升华收尾(grow worthy of the word)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The government should take measures to solve the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than lamenting the crisis in idle words, the authorities must take swift and decisive measures — tightening regulations, raising public awareness, and holding polluters firmly to account — before the damage becomes beyond repair. （议论文·治理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than + doing 对比开头 + swift and decisive 双形容词强化 + 破折号内三项动名词排比 + before 从句制造紧迫感(beyond repair)

original_sentence: As we walk the "path of life", we may sometimes wish to be alone with our own thoughts, for quiet periods of reflection can lead to personal improvement.
readingExamples: As we walk the "path of life", we may sometimes wish to be alone with our own thoughts, for quiet periods of reflection can lead to personal improvement.
definitionEn:
(1) n. serious and careful thought about something over a period of time
(2) n. an image that you can see in a mirror, water, or a shiny surface
(3) n. the throwing back of light, heat, or sound from a surface
(4) n. a sign, expression, or result that shows the true nature of a situation, quality, or feeling

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映，体现（某状况／本质的表现）
uncommonMeanings.example: The messy, half-finished sketches scattered across his desk were a faithful reflection of the turmoil raging inside him that sleepless week. （读后续写·心理外化·熟词僻义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （a reflection on）对……的负面评价／有损名声之事
uncommonMeanings.example: Failing the exam was no reflection on her intelligence, only on the cruel timing of her mother's illness. （读后续写·为人辩护·僻义）

posExamples.sentence: As we walk the winding path of life, we sometimes long to be alone with our thoughts, for quiet moments of reflection can lead to real personal growth. （读后续写·人生感悟）
I would suggest setting aside ten minutes each evening for reflection, so that we may learn from the day's mistakes instead of repeating them tomorrow. （应用文·建议信）
Without honest reflection, experience teaches us nothing; it is only when we pause to examine our failures that they are transformed into wisdom. （议论文·反思与成长）
Kneeling by the still pond, the little girl reached out to touch her own reflection, and for the first time she smiled at the face rippling gently on the water. （读后续写·童真画面）

idioms.example: On reflection, I realised that the harsh words I had flung at my mother sprang not from anger but from a fear I could not yet name. （读后续写·顿悟）
The overflowing bins outside the classroom were a sad reflection of how little we cared for the space we shared. （议论文·环保/公德）

collocations.example: Quiet reflection by the lakeside slowly untangled the knots that months of noise had tied in my mind. （读后续写·内心平静）
After the funeral, the family sat together in a long moment of reflection, each lost in memories too tender for words. （读后续写·哀思）
On further reflection, I decided that apologising in person, however awkward, was the only honest thing to do. （读后续写·决定）
She caught her reflection in the shop window and barely recognised the confident young woman staring back. （读后续写·蜕变）
True growth begins with honest self-reflection, for we cannot change what we refuse to face. （议论文·成长）
The warmth of a community is often a reflection of the small kindnesses its members show one another. （议论文·社会）
Grandfather sat by the window, lost in reflection, watching the autumn leaves drift silently to the ground. （读后续写·画面/氛围）
The documentary's final image — an empty desk in a flooded school — invited a reflection that no words could have forced. （议论文·艺术感染力）

synonyms.example: In the hush of the empty temple, hours of quiet contemplation gradually washed the anger from his heart. （读后续写·平静）
synonyms.usage: contemplation 更文学、更庄重,常指长时间凝神冥想;reflection 更通用,可指对具体经历/错误的"反思"。写唯美意境用 contemplation,写反省总结用 reflection。

synonyms.example: It took painful introspection for him to admit that the failure had been his own doing. （议论文·自我审视）
synonyms.usage: introspection 学术、心理色彩强,专指"向内审视自己的内心/动机";reflection 范围更广,也可对外部事件。强调剖析内心用 introspection。

synonyms.translation: 沉思，冥想（常带精神/宗教意味）
synonyms.example: Each dawn she practised meditation on the hilltop, letting the rising sun still the restless waves of her thoughts. （读后续写·修心）
synonyms.usage: meditation 常指一种"静心练习/冥想活动",偏行为;reflection 侧重"就某事深思"这一思维过程。写练习/仪式用 meditation,写思考内容用 reflection。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was only in quiet reflection that sb. came to see ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was only in the quiet reflection of that long, starlit night that I came to see how much my parents' silence had, all along, been a language of love. （强调句 It was only in... that... + 环境烘托,续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would encourage everyone to make time for regular reflection on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would encourage everyone to make time for regular reflection on what we have learned, for a lesson unexamined is a lesson soon forgotten. （提出建议 + 谚语式收尾,说服力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: experience without reflection is merely ...
advancedExpressions.example: Experience without reflection is merely a series of things that happen to us; it is reflection that turns raw experience into lasting wisdom. （对比定义句 + 分号并列,凸显反思的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Being alone gives us time for reflection, which helps us improve.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In those rare hours of solitude, when the world falls quiet and even our own restlessness is stilled, reflection steals in like moonlight through a window — and in its soft, unhurried glow we begin, at last, to grow. （读后续写·独处/成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间/状语从句铺垫氛围(when the world falls quiet) + 明喻(like moonlight through a window) + 感官意象(soft, unhurried glow) + 副词延宕(at last)强化顿悟节奏

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should reflect on our mistakes to become better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only when we dare to turn honest reflection upon our own failures — however uncomfortable that gaze may be — do we transform stumbling blocks into stepping stones on the long road to becoming who we are meant to be. （议论文·反思与成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only when + 从句引导的部分倒装 + 破折号让步插入(however uncomfortable that gaze may be) + 对偶隐喻(stumbling blocks → stepping stones) + 升华收尾(who we are meant to be)

translation: 试图；寻找；争取 | vt. 寻求；寻找
original_sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
readingExamples: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to try to find or obtain something, especially something abstract such as help, advice, or truth
(2) v. to try or attempt to do something
(3) v. to ask for something formally or officially
(4) v. (seek out) to look hard for a particular person or thing and find them

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （sought-after）广受追捧的，抢手的（常用过去分词作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Overnight, the once-ignored painter became the most sought-after artist in the city, and collectors who had scorned his work now queued outside his humble studio. （读后续写·逆袭·熟词僻义）

posExamples.sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful not to escape entirely into a world of our own and lose touch with those who love us. （读后续写·人生哲思）
Should you ever feel overwhelmed by your studies, I sincerely encourage you to seek help from your teachers rather than struggle in lonely silence. （应用文·建议信）
Those who seek success without effort are chasing a mirage; genuine achievement is granted only to hands willing to labour and hearts willing to endure. （议论文·努力与成功）
Lost in the vast crowd of the railway station, the little boy anxiously sought his mother's familiar face, his small heart pounding harder with every passing second. （读后续写·紧张/寻找）

idioms.example: At just sixteen, he left his sleepy mountain village to seek his fortune in the dazzling, unforgiving city. （读后续写·离乡追梦）
As the storm broke, the frightened travellers sought shelter beneath an ancient oak, huddling together against the driving rain. （读后续写·环境/患难）
Her handmade lanterns soon became much sought-after, lighting up festivals in villages she had never even visited. （读后续写·手艺成名）

collocations.example: There is no shame in seeking advice; even the wisest among us once stood where you now stand, unsure and afraid. （应用文·安慰/鼓励）

collocations.translation: 试图做某事，力求做某事
collocations.example: Throughout his life he sought to bridge the gulf between the rich and the poor, one small act of generosity at a time. （议论文·人物精神）
Instead of waiting to be noticed, she boldly sought out the professor after class to share the idea burning in her mind. （读后续写·主动争取）
A true scholar seeks the truth even when it overturns everything he once believed to be certain. （议论文·治学）
Rather than seek revenge on those who had wronged him, he chose the harder path of forgiveness. （读后续写·品格/宽恕）
We are writing to seek your permission to hold a charity concert in the school hall next Friday evening. （应用文·请求信）
After the loss of her closest friend, she sought comfort in the worn pages of the books they had once read aloud together. （读后续写·哀伤/慰藉）
Before we rush to judge, we should first seek to understand the hidden burdens others silently carry. （议论文·同理心）

synonyms.example: No matter how many doors slammed in her face, she refused to stop pursuing the dream that had taken root in her childhood. （读后续写·追梦）
synonyms.usage: pursue 强调"持续不懈地追逐"(目标/事业/梦想),有过程感和坚持;seek 更中性,泛指"寻求、试图得到"。写"锲而不舍地追求"用 pursue,泛指寻求用 seek。

synonyms.example: For three days the villagers searched for the missing child, combing every ditch and thicket until hope itself began to fade. （读后续写·搜救）
synonyms.usage: search for 指"到处翻找具体的人／物",动作性强,常搭配地点;seek 更抽象、更正式,可求 help/truth/advice 等抽象事物。找具体东西用 search for,求抽象事物用 seek。

synonyms.example: Every athlete on that track was striving for a glory that only one of them could claim. （议论文·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: strive for 强调"竭尽全力去争取",含艰苦奋斗之意;seek to do 侧重"试图、设法"。突出拼搏用 strive for,平实表"设法"用 seek to。

advancedExpressions.expression: in seeking ..., sb. unexpectedly found ...
advancedExpressions.example: In seeking a place to hide from the world, she unexpectedly found the courage to face it — for solitude, she learned, is not a wall but a window. （in seeking..., 分词状语 + 意外转折 + 隐喻收束,续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would strongly urge you to seek ... rather than ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly urge you to seek support from those around you rather than shoulder every burden alone, for a trouble shared is a trouble halved. （seek...rather than... 对比 + 谚语收尾,劝慰力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who seek ... must first be willing to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who seek greatness must first be willing to embrace the loneliness, the doubt, and the countless quiet failures that inevitably pave the road towards it. （Those who seek...must first... 条件式论断 + 三项排比,增强论辩力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When we want to be alone, we should not escape from the world completely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When we seek the quiet company of our own thoughts, we must take care that solitude does not harden into a shell — for the soul that shuts out the world entirely soon forgets how to feel its warmth. （读后续写·独处/哲思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: seek 替换 want 提升文采 + 隐喻(harden into a shell) + for 引导原因说理 + 拟人升华(the soul...forgets how to feel its warmth)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Successful people work hard instead of seeking success without effort.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those who seek success without sweat are but chasing shadows on the wall; for genuine achievement, history reminds us again and again, has never once been handed to the idle, but earned inch by inch by the diligent. （议论文·努力与成功）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Those who... 主语从句 + 隐喻(chasing shadows on the wall) + 分号转折说理 + 插入语(history reminds us) + not...but... 对比 + inch by inch 强化艰辛

translation: 逃脱，躲避；逃跑；避开，避免；被遗忘 | n. 逃离，逃脱
original_sentence: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
readingExamples: However, when we seek to be alone, we must be careful that we do not always escape into our own world.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to get away from a place where you are in danger, or from a person or situation you want to avoid
(2) v. to avoid something unpleasant, dangerous, or difficult
(3) n. an act of getting away from a dangerous or unpleasant place or situation
(4) v. (of gas, liquid, etc.) to leak out from a pipe or container

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 被（某人）忘记；不被注意到
uncommonMeanings.example: Try as she might, the name of that old song escaped her, hovering just beyond the reach of memory like a word on the tip of one's tongue. （读后续写·记忆·怅然若失）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对现实的）逃避，消遣
uncommonMeanings.example: For the overworked clerk, those late-night detective novels were his only escape — a doorway through which he could slip out of a grey life into a world of danger and wonder. （读后续写·平凡人物·精神慰藉）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the alarm shrieked, the trapped hikers scrambled up the cliff, desperate to escape before the rising flood swallowed the narrow gorge whole. （读后续写·险境求生）
I am writing to remind fellow students that no one can escape the consequences of careless waste; every drop of water we save today secures a greener tomorrow for all. （应用文·倡议书）
For many teenagers buried under mountains of homework, sport is not merely exercise but a much-needed escape that restores both body and spirit. （议论文·青少年成长）
As the smoke curled under the door, she pressed a wet towel to her face and crawled towards the window, refusing to let panic rob her of the one chance to escape. （读后续写·火灾脱险）

idioms.example: It was a narrow escape; had the driver braked a second later, the child chasing the ball would surely have been struck. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
The subtle tremor in his voice did not escape the attention of the seasoned teacher, who gently asked what was troubling him. （读后续写·师生·细节洞察）

collocations.example: The prisoners of war dug for months before they finally managed to escape from the heavily guarded camp under cover of darkness. （读后续写·战争·越狱）
Whenever the quarrels at home grew too loud, the boy would escape into a world of his own, one built from picture books and quiet daydreams. （读后续写·童年·心理避难）
The fire officer stressed that every household should plan a clear route of escape long before an emergency ever arises. （应用文·安全须知）
The novel drives home a timeless truth: those who wrong others may escape punishment for a while, but never forever. （议论文·道德与正义）
By some miracle, all the passengers escaped unhurt from the overturned bus, though the vehicle itself was beyond repair. （读后续写·事故·万幸）
Looking back on that lucky escape, the mountaineer never again set off without checking the weather forecast. （读后续写·反思·成长）
Some students bury themselves in video games to escape reality, yet the problems they flee only pile higher in their absence. （议论文·青少年·沉迷网络）
